plainLanguage: Section 64 is repealed and contains no current substantive offence text.
meaning: Section 64 must be applied from its complete statutory wording, including any definitions, territorial conditions, licence requirements and prosecution safeguards.
keyPoints: The repeal is attributed to Act No. 3 of 1976 s. 55.

legalTerms.meaning: Provision removed from current substantive Code.

history.summary: Section 64 appears in Chapter VIII of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The exact statutory elements should be matched to evidence rather than inferred from the offence label.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Express licence, jurisdiction or prosecution-consent requirements are material to legal analysis.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na procedure zinatimiza requirements zote za section 64?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
